definitions.gloss: cherry blossoms viewed at night, nighttime cherry blossom viewing
definitions.explanation: Cherry blossoms illuminated and enjoyed at night, typically lit up with lanterns or spotlights. A seasonal tradition in Japan during spring.

examples.english: To go see the cherry blossoms at night.

examples.japanese: ⟦ライトアップ→ライトアップ：11220_raitoappu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧{夜桜|よざくら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{幻想的|げんそうてき}→幻想的：25756_gensouteki⟧だった。
examples.english: The illuminated cherry blossoms at night were very enchanting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{夜桜|よざくら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧たち⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧{酒|ざけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: We enjoyed the cherry blossoms at night in the park while drinking sake with friends.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Many parks and temples set up special lighting during cherry blossom season to allow visitors to enjoy {夜桜|よざくら}. The blossoms appear pale and ethereal under artificial light, creating a different atmosphere from daytime viewing. {夜桜|よざくら}⟦{見物|けんぶつ}→見物：01398_kenbutsu⟧ (nighttime cherry blossom viewing) is a popular spring activity.

FORMS:
{夜|よ} (night) + ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧ (cherry blossom). The さ becomes ざ through rendaku (sequential voicing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夜桜|よざくら}⟦{見物|けんぶつ}→見物：01398_kenbutsu⟧: nighttime cherry blossom viewing
- {夜桜|よざくら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ライトアップ→ライトアップ：11220_raitoappu⟧: nighttime cherry blossom illumination
- {夜桜|よざくら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: to enjoy nighttime cherry blossoms
